input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere: a full-text search for "insur" returns only the recital reference to third-party "mortgage insurers" (p0005), and the sections that would naturally carry it — Section 12 (Indemnity, p0070-p0077), Section 11 (Standard of Care, p0069), Section 3 (Hosting Services, p0030-p0042) and the miscellaneous Sections 13-30 — are silent. TrueLink is a hosting vendor that stores our Web Site and data files on its servers (p0031, p0038) and transmits and archives borrower Credit Data (p0015, p0042), so the absence of any cover falls in walk-away territory (no insurance for a vendor that processes personal data) and fails both fallback elements (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). TrueLink's indemnity at Section 12(b) is also unbacked, and its liability for Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11 is capped at 12 months' hosting and support fees (p0077), making insurance the practical source of recovery. We therefore insert a short Section 12(c) at the preferred limits; if TrueLink resists, the fallback of E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber USD 2,000,000 is acceptable.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 12(c) requiring TrueLink to carry commercial general liability, professional (E&O), cyber/privacy and workers' compensation insurance, with certificates on request.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] TrueLink hosts our Web Site and processes borrower Credit Data, but the Agreement contains no insurance covenant, so we have added a short insurance subsection at our preferred limits (CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, certificates on request). If limits are an issue, we can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M.

ops.text: Insurance. TrueLink shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: (i) commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; (ii) professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; (iii) cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 covering its processing of Credit Data and other Client data; and (iv) workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. TrueLink shall provide Client with certificates of insurance upon request.
